g.title: CRW-01-light — Change Request attention inbox (light)
g.desc: /t/acme/changes?view=needs-attention · truthful subset: 3 attention rows with server-projected reason and expected actor; no-match, unauthorized and safe-error states never fall back to an unfiltered list

g.text: Work needing action first — every row says why it needs someone and who that is.
server-projected reason and expected actor · a list, never kanban
waiting on you — j.reyes, engineering reviewer
waiting on the author — j.reyes (you) pushes a new revision
change_04 (open · verified) and change_05 (closed · cancelled) need no one's action — they stay in their own views, never here.

svg.text: CRW-01 — Change attention inbox route: /t/acme/changes params: ?view=needs-attention pattern: R-LIST

states: only matching rows; per-row reason (your review requested / required Evidence missing / changes requested), expected actor and owner; lifecycle (incl. draft) and verification stay separate; search over title, owner, service, repo, PR; no-match/unauthorized/WYRD_CHANGE_502 keep the filter
links: row → /changes/{id}; view → ?view={open|needs-attention|verified|closed}; New Change Request → /changes/new; Retry keeps ?view
